title: calochortus nanus
intro: Calochortus nanus, commonly known as the dwarf mariposa lily, is a small, delicate plant species belonging to the lily family (Liliaceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing swelling and protecting cells from damage. The therapeutic actions of Calochortus nanus include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, potentially aiding in the treatment of various conditions such as arthritis and skin disorders. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been identified in the plant's roots and other parts.
